import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_normcomp_b()
    return nothing
end

function normcomp_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, w, wb, i_n)
    for i_x = 1:i_n
        w[i_x] = u[i_x] - v[i_x]
    end
    for i_x2 = 1:i_n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + w[i_x2] ^ 2
    end
    for i_x2 = i_n:-1:1
        wb[i_x2] = wb[i_x2] + (2 * w[i_x2]) * lossb[1]
    end
    for i_x = i_n:-1:1
        ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + wb[i_x]
        vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + -(wb[i_x])
        wb[i_x] = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_normcomp_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function normcomp_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, w, wb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_normcomp_b_1!(i_n, u, v, w)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_normcomp_b_2!(i_n, loss, w)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_normcomp_b_3!(i_n, lossb, w, wb)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_normcomp_b_4!(i_n, ub, vb, wb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_normcomp_b_1!(i_n, u, v, w)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    w[i_x] = u[i_x] - v[i_x]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_normcomp_b_2!(i_n, loss, w)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x2 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += w[i_x2] ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_normcomp_b_3!(i_n, lossb, w, wb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x2 = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    wb[i_x2] = wb[i_x2] + (2 * w[i_x2]) * lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_normcomp_b_4!(i_n, ub, vb, wb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + wb[i_x]
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + -(wb[i_x])
    wb[i_x] = 0.0
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_n = 3

__seed_loss = [Float64[0.6223106219484991, 1.2065727109178608, 0.1547916583581198, 0.1948250635633255], Float64[1.3332103372283295, -1.872568497389099, -1.6574399379658158, -0.1413621576183997], Float64[0.9160899763701863, -0.1334404768312122, -1.1032659558981461, -0.40735505749320805]]
__seed_u = [Float64[0.35627848521394645, -0.3340295724277624, -0.7576038449794398, -0.6758877633708299], Float64[-2.581928347987102, -0.4836525566573796, -0.3062814286664892, 0.6874088351013703], Float64[-0.5263491371223951, -2.9753845648460047, 1.4004432174565786, -0.7862081826731915]]
__seed_v = [Float64[1.4845144807716493, 0.4174290790484065, 1.5328602974981043, 1.2742564557107119], Float64[-0.41117618980253695, -0.310025196413952, -0.5600742604632911, 1.2161008157510962], Float64[0.06908857979865486, 0.8190926531565415, 0.40402526966814545, -2.125071827730649]]
__seed_w = [Float64[0.7305691739275169, -0.4153781541327313, 1.4092331017484923, 1.1156354488729574], Float64[-0.9460284822753653, -1.0652540830148984, -0.4832518506388386, -0.08565048537395877], Float64[-0.26373727004319136, 0.23649997692177818, -1.0016681599018882, 0.0011085527247866249]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:3
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  v_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_v); v_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_v[__trial])
  v_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_v)); v_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_v[__trial]))
  w_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_w); w_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_w[__trial])
  w_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_w)); w_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_w[__trial]))
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_normcomp_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_normcomp_b_cuda, Any[])
  ret_cpu = normcomp_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, v_val_cpu, v_sh_cpu, w_val_cpu, w_sh_cpu, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = normcomp_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, v_val_gpu, v_sh_gpu, w_val_gpu, w_sh_gpu, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ()
  ret_gpu_t = ()
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))

  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))

  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
